## Goal
Implement Go-side invocation of script-defined functions/closures in the Tengo repo (`/app`, module `github.com/d5/tengo/v2`), so callables obtained from globals, nested arrays/maps, source-module exports, or Go callback args can be called via `Object.Call` with in-script semantics (globals, imports, closure captures, variadic, recursion, return values, runtime error formatting). Transferred/cloned callables must be isolated: captured locals snapshotted at transfer time, globals resolve against destination instance, isolation applied recursively to callables nested in arrays/maps. Keep public entrypoint on current callable objects. Work on branch `feature/callable-instance-isolation`, commit, push to origin. Do NOT overwrite commits already on the remote branch (user explicitly said so).

## Constraints & Preferences
- Branch must be `feature/callable-instance-isolation` created from master; commit and push to origin (`/srv/git/tengo.git`).
- Remote branch already contains commits `f8fdf1b` "more notes, not working yet" and `9a50fcd` "try a different callable isolation approach" (only `scratch/callable-notes.md`) — user: "Don't overwrite the commits that are already on that branch."
- Finish by issuing exactly `echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT` (alone, no other commands).
- Each response must include ≥1 bash tool call; env changes don't persist across subshells.
- Existing test conventions: repo's `require` package lacks `Contains`/`Len` (use `strings.Contains`, `len()`).

## Progress
### Done
- Explored codebase: `objects.go` (CompiledFunction, ObjectPtr), `vm.go` (closures, OpCall/OpReturn, free vars), `script.go` (Compiled.Get/GetAll/Set/Clone, Script.Compile), `compiler.go`, bytecode, tests.
- Implemented in `objects.go`: `runtime *callableRuntime` field on `CompiledFunction`; `Call(args ...Object)` method; `Copy()` preserves SourceMap + runtime.
- Implemented in `vm.go`: `callableRuntime` (constants, fileSet, globals, maxAllocs, globalIndexes, globalMap); `transferRuntime(src,dst)` name-based global remap (unmapped → -1 → undefined); `resolveGlobal`; `frame.runtime`; `switchRuntime`; `bindConstant` with `boundConstants` VM cache; `formatRuntimeError`/`frameFileSet` (per-frame file sets); `callableRuntime.call` direct-call entrypoint (variadic packing, wrong-num-args via `wrongNumArguments`, alloc limit, stack-size guard); OpConstant binds functions; OpClosure sets runtime; OpCall/OpReturn switch/restore runtime; framesIndex==1 return exits via `v.ret`.
- Implemented in `script.go`: `getRuntime`; `transferCallables`/`transferObjectMemo` (cycle-safe memo, snapshots `ObjectPtr` captures, preserves shared cells, recursive through Array/ImmutableArray/Map/ImmutableMap/Error); `bindObjectInPlace`/`hasUnboundCallable`/`containsCallable`; `callablesBoundToGlobals`/`sameGlobals` (same-instance detection); wired into `Script.Compile` (transfer callable globals via shared memo), `Clone` (all globals through shared memo when any callable present, else `Copy()`), `Set`, `Get`/`GetAll` (conditional write-lock upgrade only when unbound callables present).
- Updated `variable.go` Object() doc; added docs section "Calling Script Functions from Go" in `docs/interoperability.md` (placed before `## Concurrency`).
- Added repo tests to `script_test.go`: `TestCompiled_Call`, `_CallClosure`, `_CallVariadic`, `_CallRecursion`, `_CallRuntimeError`, `_CallSourceModule`, `_CloneCallableIsolation`, `_CloneNestedCallableIsolation`, `_TransferCallable`, `_TransferNestedCallables`, `_CallFromGoCallback`, `_TransferGlobalResolution`, `_CallReturnedClosure`, `_CallReturnedCompositeCallable`, `TestScript_AddCallableIsolation`.
- All checks pass: `go build`, `go vet`, `go test -count=1 ./...`, `go test -race ./...`, gofmt clean; 19 manual harnesses in `/tmp/repro/iso.go`…`iso19.go`, `errfmt.go` all "ALL PASS"; error-trace parity verified across source files (`at bad:1:32` + `at (main):1:44`); CLI smoke test OK.

## Key Decisions
- **Separate constants/fileSet from globals in `callableRuntime`**: transferred closures keep source bytecode constants but resolve globals against destination instance (spec: globals resolve against destination).
- **Snapshot captures at transfer via memoized `ObjectPtr` cell copy**: closures sharing a captured variable also share the snapshotted cell in the transferred copy; aliases between globals preserved by routing all globals through one shared memo.
- **Name-based global index remap (`globalMap`)**: handles differently-shaped instances; missing names resolve to `-1` → undefined (read) or ignored (write).
- **In-place binding in `Get`/`GetAll`** (only for unbound callables, with lock upgrade): mutations through returned values stay visible to the instance (in-script behavior).
- **`callablesBoundToGlobals`/`sameGlobals` via slice head identity**: assigning a callable back to its own instance preserves identity instead of snapshotting.
- **`bindConstant` cache (`boundConstants`)**: keeps repeated constant evaluation returning the same bound function object so tail-call detection (`callee == v.curFrame.fn`) still works.

4. Final sanity: `git log --oneline origin/feature/callable-instance-isolation -3`.
5. Run `echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT` (alone, as the last command).

## Critical Context

- Changed files: `objects.go`, `vm.go`, `script.go`, `variable.go`, `script_test.go`, `docs/interoperability.md` (all committed in `6898260`).
- Key transfer semantics verified: destination sees captures as of transfer time (e.g. source counter at 3 → dest call gives 4, source unaffected; snapshot capture 50+5=55; nested closure 7+3=10; shared pair cells `inc→1`/`mul→10`); absent destination global → undefined; present dest global (e.g. `g := 999`) → resolved; module exports (incl. nested source-module imports) stay callable → 202; transferred error traces keep original file (`at bad:1:32`).
- Error format parity: `"Runtime Error: not callable: int\n\tat (main):1:30"`; wrong args: `"Runtime Error: wrong number of arguments: want>=1, got=0"` / `want=3, got=1`; alloc limit: `"Runtime Error: object allocation limit exceeded"`.
- Test harnesses live in `/tmp/repro/` (module `repro`, `replace github.com/d5/tengo/v2 => /app`); run e.g. `cd /tmp/repro && go run iso.go`.
- VM internals: `framesIndex==1` means direct Go-side call outermost frame; `OpReturn` sets `v.ret` and returns; variadic call packs tail into `&Array{}`; `StackSize` guard on `NumLocals`/`len(args)`.
